I'm always reluctant to say "first" because I never know if there's some obscure thing I've never heard of which came previously, but I'm going to try here: Strange Adventure in Infinite Space was the first game to pioneer the, lets call it, fast adventure genre. Games which share the trappings and language of huge time sinks (RPGs, 4x games, roguelikes,...) but manage to package it all in a light and quick format.

Their tag line is: "Explore the galaxy...in 20 minutes or less!"

There is also a sequel, Weird Worlds - Return to Infinite Space, which is great but not free, and an upcoming third game, Infinite Space 3: Sea of Stars. I absolutely would have Kickstarted that if I had known about it, but I missed the opportunity. (though there's no Linux version. ::sigh::)
